title: Advancing Multi-Agent RAG Systems with Minimalist Reinforcement Learning

defines.name: Mujica-MyGo
defines.definition: A unified framework for efficient multi-turn reasoning in RAG that combines a multi-agent planner-worker workflow with a minimalist reinforcement learning method.

defines.name: Mujica
defines.definition: A multi-agent RAG workflow that decomposes complex multi-turn interactions into cooperative sub-interactions to mitigate long-context issues.

defines.name: MyGO
defines.definition: A minimalist policy gradient optimization algorithm for post-training LLMs in complex RAG pipelines without relying on in-context learning.

problem: Multi-turn RAG pipelines create long intermediate contexts and in-context learning prompts that exceed context limits and hurt performance, while post-training such systems is difficult with standard supervised or RL methods.
